Replace the real split-screen composite at 6:01 (P4 06_same_thing; assembler explicitly joins left/right plates) with sequential full-frame moving shots or one appropriate moving plate; retime the alpha explanation to those shots, keep it off Franklin and the hero object, and ensure phone legibility. The source assembler is currently untracked in the shared HOS checkout: preserve it and commit a versioned v02 assembler from a clean worktree.
2. Recompose 7:58 P5 10_metal_easy: white linework currently covers the worker/ladder and the label disappears against brick. Keep the rod/path explanation legible and away from the subject. The apparent detector seam may be architectural; do not label it a confirmed split without checking in motion.
3. Inspect 2:30 P2 09_window_storm in motion: the sampled sheet appears to show a natural window edge, not a pasted panel. Try an honest subject-preserving reframe within upscale limits using existing moving footage, then rerun unchanged gates. If a genuine detector defect remains, document it for a separate gate-fix review; never suppress or weaken the check to pass this cut.
4. Review all six low-detail WARN rows full size and in motion: 1:22 bells, 2:53 likeness pairs, 4:38 wet/dry, 5:02 kite climb, 7:15 wire bells, 7:53 wood/metal. The contact sheet alone does not clear motion, scientific meaning or phone legibility. Check the recorded freeze_lines in parts 2-5 (6/13/6/10), distinguish actual freezes from detector events, and remove any real freeze without VO changes.
5. Apply J1193 per-row graphics findings when available; it remains a required input to final graphics approval. Repairs can start now. If it has not landed by delivery, record a dependency on J1193 rather than another generic Chief hold. Check all Teach on screen and Polish items for this film, not just automated image gates.
6. Run picture_qa, polish_gate and episode gate; produce full-runtime contact sheets and each flagged frame. Music is still absent: SKIPPED_NO_BED is NOT PASS. This is a VO-only diagnostic rough, not a finished cut. Do not generate a bed under this job. Report SFX/music finishing still outstanding explicitly.
7. Copy v02 to durable NAS/desk review storage with SHA256, and commit text evidence, reproducible assembler, production-status and HOS PIPELINE/status-board updates from a clean worktree in a PR. No Ben Ready-for-OK card. Park for Chief review only with specific evidence and remaining blockers. Original J1213 stays held pending this repair and J1193.

Check disk before render, use mounted NAS scratch if needed, never write into an unmounted share or delete NAS files. jobs.title: Uranus v08: correct opening shake and verify playable UAT delivery (J1220 FIX)
jobs.body:
Acting Chief Codex ruling on J1220: FIX, not PASS. Ben's 29 Oct 20:12 request remains '0:00 the image is shaky' (#264 6507250708). Make a new v08 without overwriting v06/v07 or any uploaded file. No spend, upload, schedule, privacy, Buffer or UPLOADS changes.

Read jobs/reviews/J1220/CHIEF_RULING_2026-10-29.md and CHIEF_MOTION_DIAGNOSTIC.json first. v07 stabilize_cycle subtracts a constant mean step (lines 330-334); it does not smooth the measured per-frame path. jobs.title: Uranus v10: motion-compensated opening and precise path evidence (J1240 FIX)
jobs.body:
# J1240 elected Chief review — 30 October 2026

Reviewer: codex, elected acting Chief; authority rechecked with chief_relay.py status.

## Ruling: FIX, not PASS

Reviewed the job body/result/history, J1225 motion evidence, v09 delivery note, renderer, final-sha gate records, full opening contact sheet and full-size 0.40s frame. This is an implementation/evidence ruling; no claim of real-time audiovisual playback. The existing reported gate PASSes are retained, not overridden. No final OK or Ben-watch handoff.

Independently read and SHA-256 checked the actual iCloud and NAS masters: both match `458b1f67d08c567166b49e416fa3e8fefaec7c1a6cce8c3303305b853f8a3535`.

## Why another correction is necessary

1. `_assemble_uranus_v09.py` sample_open (lines 445–458) crossfades two displaced source frames. It does not spatially align them before interpolation. Its three shutter samples (lines 476–495) are averages of those same unaligned frames. This is temporal blending, not the requested sub-pixel resampling of moving detail. A nominal 1.5 px path does not establish actual ring motion; ghosting/shimmer remains a risk on these thin arcs.
2. The renderer assumes exactly 4 px per source interval (lines 394–398) and reports the designed source-time curve as pixel motion. It neither measures that mapping nor includes the final zoom in those reported steps. Delivered measurements disagree: v09 peak step 3.0 px and maximum step change 3.0 px, against requested 1.5 / 0.25. These are corroboration, not newly invented gates, and could include estimator error; that disagreement must be resolved before PASS.
3. The estimator uses a 2x image resize plus integer FFT peak: resolution is 0.5 px, too coarse to validate 0.25 px step changes. Flicker falls 3.19777 -> 2.75916 (13.7%), and step-change max 4 -> 3, but this alone cannot prove the requested path. Committed MOTION_DIAGNOSTIC.json contains summaries only, with no per-frame steps for any version.
4. The opening ends at a designed 0.70 px/frame rather than rest. Avoiding a gate-detected freeze is sensible, but this departure from the brief must be explicit. Chief clarification for the correction: retain a gentle continuously moving ease-out through the cut if reaching rest would violate the existing no-freeze gate; never weaken that gate.

## Authorized follow-up (assembly; GBP0)

Create a new v10, preserving v06/v07/v08/v09 and every uploaded file. Same approved NASA SVS 20390 Shot9, v06 narration, captions and timing. Prototype only the opening first: measure source motion; use motion-compensated temporal interpolation or a measured spatial sub-pixel warp of successive moving source frames. Do not crossfade unregistered displaced frames, use static/frozen replacement footage, or claim designed motion as measured motion. Use high-quality spatial resampling and 2–4 genuinely displaced shutter sub-samples; account for final crop/zoom and retain upscale <=1.85.

Validate the estimator on known synthetic fractional translations and ramps, at <=0.1 px resolution, before using it on the caption-free subject ROI. Supply full per-frame steps, step changes, confidence/ambiguity diagnostics, acceleration RMS and motion-compensated ring flicker for v06/v08/v09/v10. Investigate unreliable ROI estimates rather than silently treating them as compliance. Keep the existing requested slow path and step-change targets. Preserve every original gate. Inspect every opening frame and normal/quarter-speed playback; save the evidence and state who or what actually performed each inspection.

Only after the prototype demonstrates improvement should the worker render the full version and rerun the existing final-sha gate set (open/f0diff, loop/all finish, I/TP, polish, picture QA, music, SFX, hitch). Tail changes only for a documented forward loop, with no obvious double rings. Versioned repo-local/NAS/iCloud delivery, hashes and playable source check; no media committed to git. Park for elected-Chief review, not worker PASS. Deadline 1 November 20:00 London; if no compliant cut, explicitly report unsuccessful and preserve fallback. Ben watch deadline remains 3 November 10:30 London.

J1212 is untouched and remains held on Ben approval. No repoint, upload, scheduling, privacy, Buffer or UPLOADS mutation. Scheduled fallback ZpEA8stoSPA remains as is. No external wait is needed: correction is ready for the assembly lane.

Disk: required NAS offload was attempted with access available; no scratch met the safe 48-hour age threshold. About 13 GB free. No render started during this review.

jobs.title: Daily Studio read: long films (impressions, CTR, views, avg % viewed) + Shorts (views, avg % viewed, stayed to watch) -> tracker
jobs.body: Free, read-only. Runs daily after the 06:40 snapshot and must finish before 09:00 London (Ben, 12 Oct 22:19). 1) In YouTube Studio, read only, change nothing: Orbit With Ben in the Orbit Studio browser (CDP 9223); History of Science in its own signed-in Studio session (never the 9222 Flow browser for Orbit pages). 2) For every long film (format long in 05_Analytics/dashboard/data.json, both channels), open Analytics > Reach for the video, period Lifetime, and read Impressions and Impressions click-through rate (%), and on Overview/Engagement the lifetime Views, Average view duration (seconds) and Average percentage viewed (%; if Studio shows only duration, compute duration / video length x 100). 2b) For every Short (both channels), read lifetime Views, Average percentage viewed (%) and 'Stayed to watch' (%, Studio's Shorts engagement figure, viewed vs swiped away); write them under the same videos map as "views", "avgViewPct" and "stayedToWatch" (Ben, 12 Oct 22:50). 3) Write 05_Analytics/<owb|hos>/studio_ctr.json: {"readAt": <ISO UTC>, "period": "lifetime", "videos": {"<videoId>": {"impressions": <int>, "impressionsCtr": <number, % e.g. 3.8>, "views": <int>, "avgViewSeconds": <int>, "avgViewPct": <number, %>}}}. A film Studio can't show yet: leave it out. 4) Rebuild: cd 07_Content-Ops && npx tsx scripts/analytics-report.ts (it merges studio_ctr.json into data.json; Studio values take priority on the tracker), then python3 scripts/board_publish.py so /tracker's 'Long films vs targets' panel fills in. 5) Commit only those files to main with a message naming the counts, then jobs.py done <id> --result "<n> OWB + <m> HOS longs; CTR hits vs 4%: ..." --git. Never: edit any video, title, thumbnail or setting; spend anything; paid API.

jobs.body:
Chief (Grok) ruling h13 on J1261, 30 Oct (HOS #180, re Gemini 6522827968 / Claude 6521114044). HOS PR #387 (592eaae7, branch gemini/j1259-release-gate-chapters-sources) is FIX: do not merge as built. The check itself is right; where it bites is wrong.

Why: package-lint lints EVERY film's long package, and hos-contract.yml runs it on every PR touching any 11_Upload-Package/, SHORTS_RELEASE.json, SHORTS_LOG.md or LIVE_VIDEOS.json, and on push to main. With #387 as built, the contract check goes red on main and on every such PR (e.g. #386-style 007 records fixes) because of 008/009/010, which aren't at release yet. Chief only merges on green CI, so unrelated work would be blocked or would have to be merged red. Every new film scaffold (011+) would also turn main red the day it is created.

Do (on the SAME branch, a new normal commit on top of 592eaae7; no force-push, no rebase, no new PR):
1. Keep checkChaptersAndSources() and its rules exactly as Claude wrote them (0:00 first, >=3 stamps, each >=10 s after the last; a Sources block with a source under it). Give it a severity argument.
2. In lintLongPackage, make the findings release-stage: ERROR (description.chapters / description.sources) when the package is at release, i.e. m.video is a non-empty string (the final master is attached for upload) OR m.schedule is a string and input.now is set and schedule - now <= 7 days. Otherwise WARN with the same rule ids and the same messages plus " (blocks at release)". Shorts stay exempt.
3. Tests in tests/hos-contract.test.ts: keep Claude's 4; add (a) a draft package with neither block, video null, schedule 30 days out -> both findings present as warn, no error; (b) same package with video set -> both are error; (c) same package with video null and schedule 3 days out -> both are error. Keep the good-package fixture with both blocks.
4. Run in 07_Content-Ops: npx vitest run (expect all pass) and npx tsx scripts/package-lint.ts (expect exit 0 today, 30 Oct: 008/009/010 PASS with description.chapters + description.sources warns and nothing else new; 006/007 PASS; public longs SKIP). Paste both outputs on the PR.
5. One line in STUDIO_PLAYBOOK.md section 9 (or AGENTS.md "Definition of done", whichever already lists package-lint): a long's description needs Chapters + Sources; package-lint warns while drafting and fails once the master is attached or the slot is 7 days out.
6. CI on the new head: check, contract, no-media, no-desk-close all green. Update the PR body: "contract is green; the gate fails at release, not while drafting". Park for Chief: release-gate PR review (merge). Don't merge yourself.
Note: 008 airs Thu 19 Nov 18:00Z, so the gate goes hard on 12 Nov 18:00Z at the latest; the chapters/sources jobs queued with this ruling must land before then. Don't edit 008/009/010 descriptions in this job. No YouTube/Studio change. GBP0.
